# gi.write.write_brgi_db_to_file { #bedrock_ge.gi.write.write_brgi_db_to_file }

```python
gi.write.write_brgi_db_to_file(brgi_db, path, driver='GPKG')
```

Writes a Bedrock GI (geospatial) database to a file.

Writes a Bedrock GI (geospatial) database to a file. The file type is
determined by the `driver` argument. Possible values are "GPKG" and "EXCEL".

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                             | Description                                                          | Default    |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| brgi_db | BedrockGIDatabase \| BedrockGIGeospatialDatabase | The Bedrock GI (geospatial) database.                                | _required_ |
| path    | str \| Path                                      | The path of the output file.                                         | _required_ |
| driver  | Literal\[\'EXCEL\', \'GPKG\'\]                   | The type of the output file. Possible values are "GPKG" and "EXCEL". | `'GPKG'`   |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description   |
|--------|--------|---------------|
|        | None   | None          |
